instruction: You are the receiving specialist for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-036 (Receive a lot-controlled relay shipment). Match packing slip, PO, certificate, and dock count before creating the receipt request with the supplier lot. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, send the scoped completion email; then write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell. Return exactly: receipt_reference, inspection_disposition, accepted_quantity.

A write is permitted only after the record identity, effective revision, quantity or amount, and recorded approval agree. Preserve task, lot, serial, supplier, project, and work-order references. Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
